Figures in the right hand margin indicate full marks.

notes: Exam cover page confirms SCIENCE, Subject Code 212, Secondary School Examination 2024 (Annual) — correct subject, no F8-style mismatch.

Footer of this cover page already prints 'Page 4 of 40' / code 'H/S-24(M)/72042-(77/80)'. Declared Total Printed Pages = 40, but PDF has only 37 pages — gap of exactly 3. Likely explanation (unlike F7's genuine-incompleteness case): the cover itself is labelled printed-page-4, meaning printed pages 1-3 (generic candidate instructions, probably shared across all subject booklets) were never part of this PDF/scan to begin with — the missing 3 = those 3 front pages, not missing exam content. To be confirmed as pages are read (watch for any jump in question numbering or subjective-section gap like F7 had).
